notes.title: 📢 Important Announcement: Fearless Rider Will Be Moving from Free to Paid
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have an important update to share regarding the future of Fearless Rider. Soon the game will no longer be free to play and will instead be available as a paid title.

This decision wasn’t made lightly. Since launch, we’ve been overwhelmed by the support and feedback from our amazing community. Making the game free allowed us to grow, learn, and improve with your help. Now, as we move forward with new content, features, and continued development, introducing a price point will help us support the game's ongoing evolution and ensure a higher level of quality and support.

🔹 If you already own the game (downloaded it while it was free), don’t worry—you’ll continue to have full access even after the switch.

🔹 If you're new or on the fence, now is the perfect time to jump in and grab the game for free before the transition happen.

We’re incredibly grateful for your support and hope you’ll continue to be part of this journey with us. More updates and content are on the way, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.

Thank you,
— The Fearless Rider Team

notes.title: Powerups
notes.content:
Fearless Rider has received a major update. We have added powerups.

Invincibility - Make the car unhittable to obstacles

Jump - Give the ability to jump car

Skip To Checkpoint - This will move the car to the next checkpoint

Speed Booster - Increase car speed

Time - This will slow down obstacles

Enjoy!
